correctness.rationale: Inspected 1D exact UTR-Adaptive Strategy 4.1 update on f_p(x)=|x|^p/p with p>=3 and rho floor>0. Gradient magnitude a^(p-1), Hessian (p-1)a^(p-2), and ratio H/sqrt(|g|)=(p-1)a^((p-3)/2) drive branch selection. For p=3, the two branch radii and constrained Newton solutions yield q3(rho)=1/2 (rho<=1), 1-1/(2rho) (1<rho<=2), and 1-1/(4rho) (rho>2). At p>3 branch H/sqrt|g| ->0, radius a^((p-1)/2)/(4rho) is eventually active, and descent acceptance tends to 1/4>eta; accepted updates lower rho to rho_min. Exact recurrence a_{k+1}=a_k-a_k^((p-1)/2)/(4rho_min) gives a_k ~ [8rho_min/((p-3)k)]^(2/(p-3)) by inverse-power telescoping. Formula describes local infinite zero-tolerance update, not a fixed positive-stopping-tolerance run. Independently checked branch thresholds and recurrence algebra and inspected provided verification.py; finite checks alone do not establish asymptotics.

The test family is natural and the asymptotic rate is nontrivial beyond mere substitution, despite the one-dimensional and pre-termination restriction.
